info.headline: ChakraNet Warning: Extreme Cyclone Hazard (Very Severe Cyclonic Storm Phailin) at T+108h
info.description: Severe extreme-weather anomaly tracked by ChakraNet atmospheric forecasting pipeline. Anticipated high-impact heavy precipitation and gale-force wind gust risk over Ganjam, Puri, and Jagatsinghpur coastal districts (Odisha) near Gopalpur, Ganjam district, Odisha at lead time +108 hours. Classified at severity level 'Extreme'.
info.instruction: Take immediate precautionary shelter. Avoid low-lying coastal terrain and sea voyages. Follow official advisories broadcasted by IMD, NDMA, and State Disaster Management Authorities.
